# $expand values are policed, and two valid ones are refused here

**Claim.** A value outside the documented set is refused with INVALID_PARAMETER and a hint listing every valid value. Two values inside the set are still refused in a My Campaign context: `scores` with 403 and `pollingLocation` with 400.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}/get`

## Observed exchange

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Emeka",
  "lastName": "Adeyemi-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_An invented section. The hint in the refusal is the authoritative list._

```http
GET /people/100000001?%24expand=frisbees

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "'frisbees' is not a valid argument for the '$expand' parameter",
      "properties": [
        "$expand"
      ],
      "hint": "The only valid expand sections are: 'contributionHistory', 'addresses', 'phones', 'emails', 'codes', 'customFields', 'externalIds', 'preferences', 'recordedAddresses', 'reportedDemographics', 'suppressions', 'cases', 'customProperties', 'districts', 'electionRecords', 'membershipStatuses', 'notes', 'organizationRoles', 'scores', 'disclosureFieldValues', 'primaryContact', 'pollingLocation', 'biography'"
    }
  ]
}
```

_`scores` is in the valid set, but this context is refused it outright._

```http
GET /people/100000001?%24expand=scores

→ 403
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "FORBIDDEN",
      "text": "May not request 'scores'"
    }
  ]
}
```

_`pollingLocation` is also in the set, and also refused — but as a 400._

```http
GET /people/100000001?%24expand=pollingLocation

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "BAD_REQUEST",
      "text": "May not request 'pollingLocation' in this context"
    }
  ]
}
```
